title: Free Spirit Yacht Cruises
specs: Cruises on Lake Michigan and Chicago River with views of city skyline and landmarks
Custom catering and full-service bar available
Children under 90 lbs. must wear life jackets on outside deck areas; guests must provide life jackets for infants or small children
No smoking aboard; no sitting on handrails; no standing on benches or chairs; no swimming; no shots, beer bongs, or drinking games
Yachts accommodate up to 120 guests; minimum 50 person charter
Private groups only; no bachelor parties; bridal and baby showers allowed
includes: Use of yacht with indoor and outdoor spaces
Stereo system with AUX cord, XM radio, and microphone
blurb: Guests charter private yachts for events such as corporate meetings, family reunions, weddings, and parties. Cruises offer customizable experiences including catering, entertainment, and scenic views of Chicago landmarks. The yachts accommodate up to 120 guests and provide indoor and outdoor spaces with amenities like stereo systems and marine toilets.
extraNote: Non-refundable deposit of 50% required to secure date · Balance due 10 days prior to charter date in cleared funds · No refunds for inclement weather · Prices do not include tax, gratuities, or 3.5% credit card fee · Dock J slip 24 in Burnham Harbor, Chicago, about 5 minutes from downtown Chicago · April 15th – October 15th

quotes.text: We very much enjoyed our tour of the beautiful Chicago waterfront, and the excellent service and weather that you provided. We hope that sometime in the future we’ll have another opportunity to cruise together. In the meantime, we’ll certainly recommend Free Spirit to others who are looking for a cruising recommendation.

Our entire group had a marvelous time. This trip exceeded any expectations that they had. Everyone would like this to be an annual event. Thank your so much for your wonderful “hospitality”, as I know this was business for you, but you made it feel like we were with friends…You made me shine, but you deserve the credit.

A truly heartfelt thank you to you both for helping me plan my parents 30th anniversary cruise. Everyone had a fantastic time and really loved seeing navy pier from the water at pickup and just loved the cruise!!! Thank you for all of your help in planning, and fantastic execution! It was a pleasure working with you.

You and the entire crew did an UNBELIEVABLE job handling our Chemguard dinner charter event! I would not hesitate to recommend your charter service for any Chicago harbor function! A great time was had by everyone and I am sure this dinner cruise will be talked about for months to come!

Everyone had so much fun. The staff was helpful, friendly and courteous; the food was great; and the weather pretty much held up! Thanks for all your help in setting this up. I will definitely pass on recommendations to friends, co-workers and family.

I wanted to send you a note to tell you what an absolutely AMAZING time we all had Thursday!!! Everything was perfect! The food was great, the staff was awesome and the boat was beautiful!!! Thanks for everything you did to make this a fantastic day!
